What is a song that really brings you back to a certain time in your life?

Gonna get some flak for this but the first that came to mind is Higher by Creed.

Was a junior in high school when Creed was big, and we all loved it.

I remember the constant rush of leaving school and just driving to the next hangout spot and having fun without hardly a care other than what our next move was.

Good times.
I still think its a good song so no shame!! A ton of older songs like that make me feel like a kid again. Feels good.
Blood Brothers by Papa Roach really takes me back to junior high and Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2. Crazy nostalgia.

Mine would have to be Dig by Incubus. I remember seeing the music video for the first time and at the time my highschool art teacher let me pick the music to listen to during class and I would always play that. That art class was such a feel good place and that song still gives me those feelings to this day. Weird.

My brother and I shared a room for close to a decade and if one or both of us was in the room, there was music playing. We would urge each other's music discovery and I give him tons of credit for my appreciation of every genre. I remember a lot of that - the first time I heard The Wall. Talking about what we visualized and the attitude behind the music. The nuances. I remember his techno phase more than I would like to. I remember the first time I heard Metallica and Rammstein and even Van Halen's 1984 and so many others.

Oddly enough, I think of everything we listened to, it is a tossup between Grateful Dead's "In the Dark" (the whole album) and Beastie Boys' "License to Ill", most particularly Paul Revere. I remember memorizing the songs and doing little in-room mime concerts. It was a pretty great time in my life to look back on.
Sounds like an awesome relationship for sure. Paul Revere is a fantastic song!
